implementation.storage: Per-user and per-device identity pins are stored in IndexedDB and included in encrypted, explicitly restored key backups.
implementation.verification: The DM safety-number panel marks only an identity key already pinned on this device as manually verified.
implementation.key_change: Both outbound prekey processing and inbound prekey-message processing compare the pinned identity key, emit an identity-change alert, and reset verified to false on a changed key.
implementation.visibility: Identity changes are ingested by the E2EE store and surfaced in the DM trust warning and safety-number panel.
